title: Ensure code owners are set for extra sensitive code or configuration
titleZh: 敏感代码/配置设置 Code owners
description: Not automatable on Bitbucket Data Center: there is no CODEOWNERS file, and default reviewers are advisory unless combined with an approval requirement. Reported as MANUAL so the gap is visible rather than silently passing.
remediation: Repository settings -> Default reviewers -> Add default reviewer condition: scope the condition to the source and target branches that carry sensitive changes, name the owning reviewers, and set "Approvals required" to at least 1 so the review is binding rather than suggested.
remediationZh: 仓库设置 -> Default reviewers -> Add default reviewer condition：按承载敏感变更的源/目标分支限定条件，指定归属评审人，并把「Approvals required」设为至少 1，使评审具备强制力而非仅作提示。
